# RAR codec fixtures

These four binary fixtures are decoded from the upstream libarchive 3.8.9 test fixtures: test_read_format_rar, test_read_format_rar5_stored, test_read_format_rar5_compressed, and test_read_format_rar5_multiple_files_solid. They test the decoder independently of the log-member selection rules; their upstream member names are retained.

Source: https://github.com/libarchive/libarchive/tree/v3.8.9/libarchive/test
